name: Jarvis Coordinator
tagline: German-language desk coordinating six specialist bots behind conservative approval gates.
description: Written in German, it holds a fleet of six specialists together - news, office work, sales, systems and a security audit seat among them. Approvals are deliberately tight and digests arrive on a recurring rhythm, with the owner the only route for anything travelling in or out. As much fleet manifest as setup guide.
author: HBud69
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
